A highly modified, fully automatic variant of the autopistol, designed to deliver maximum short-range firepower in a compact package. Due to light weight, it is very quick to draw.

A compact, general-purpose assault rifle utilizing a bullpup configuration. The weapon's design places the action behind the trigger group, significantly reducing its overall length for enhanced maneuverability and an extremely fast draw time.
A compact designated marksman rifle utilizing a bullpup configuration. This design shifts the action back, resulting in a shorter, lighter package that enables an extremely fast draw and aiming time.

A lightweight, modern personal defense weapon designed for maximum portability and quick engagement. Its high rate of fire in a long burst makes it highly effective at close to medium range. Due to light weight, it is very quick to draw.
